entries.label: 2WD
entries.description: A conventional two-wheel-drive car can use it in normal conditions.

osm.note: Rarely tagged. Most OSM roads without 4wd_only are passable by 2WD vehicles, but OSM does not say so.

entries.label: AWD
entries.description: Needs an all-wheel-drive vehicle, or a two-wheel-drive vehicle with good ground clearance, but not low range.

entries.label: 4WD high clearance
entries.description: Needs a four-wheel-drive vehicle with high ground clearance. Not signed as 4WD only.

osm.note: A 4WD is advised but not required by sign.

entries.label: 4WD only
entries.description: Signed or declared 4WD only by the road authority or land manager. Expect low range, steep grades, deep ruts or water crossings.

entries.label: Closed to vehicles
entries.description: Closed to private motor vehicles, such as a management track open only to walkers, cyclists or authorised vehicles.

osm.note: Closed to everyone, including walkers and cyclists.
Only authorised vehicles, such as a management track.
